{{Top|leg}}
The '''Master of the Sith Temple''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rank within the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was held by the Sith who was tasked with running the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] on Kesh. By [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], that mantle was held by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Takaris Yur]], and he retained the title even after his ascension to [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] in [[44 ABY]].
